rungs.title: Account Coordinator
rungs.summary: Learning the customers, the products and the support routes.
rungs.knowledge: Knows the products, plans and how to find answers fast.
rungs.delivery: Handles routine customer requests and keeps account records current.
rungs.leadership: Is responsive and honest, and learns from account managers' calls.

rungs.title: Account Manager
rungs.summary: Owns the relationship with a set of customers.
rungs.knowledge: Fluent in the products, billing and what each customer is trying to achieve.
rungs.delivery: Keeps customers healthy and renews or grows their accounts.
rungs.leadership: Builds trust with customers and brings the delivery team in early.

rungs.title: Senior Account Manager
rungs.summary: Owns the larger accounts and their growth.
rungs.knowledge: Deep in the customer's business, pricing and what AI can change for them.
rungs.delivery: Owns larger accounts, forecasts renewals and expansion accurately.
rungs.leadership: Handles escalations and mentors account managers.

rungs.title: Head of Accounts
rungs.summary: Owns customer retention and account strategy.
rungs.knowledge: Reads the numbers behind retention, churn and expansion.
rungs.delivery: Owns retention, expansion and the account team's targets.
rungs.leadership: Leads account managers and carries the customer's voice to the executive team.
